title: 拉曼顯微光譜儀~Raman microspectrometers
focus: 拉曼位移、共軛焦取樣、瑞利光抑制、光柵色散、波數校正與雷射加熱預算~Raman shift, confocal sampling, Rayleigh rejection, grating dispersion, wavenumber calibration and laser-heating budgets
summary: 從分子振動造成的非彈性散射出發，理解拉曼顯微光譜儀如何從比入射雷射弱十個數量級的散射光中取出化學與應力資訊，再把共軛焦取樣、邊緣濾光片、光柵色散、矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 校正、螢光背景與雷射加熱整合成可交接的量測紀錄。~Start from inelastic scattering by molecular vibrations to see how a Raman microspectrometer extracts chemical and stress information from light ten orders of magnitude weaker than the laser, then integrate confocal sampling, edge filters, grating dispersion, silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ calibration, fluorescence background and laser heating into a transferable measurement record.

units.anchor: 雷射線與斯托克斯散射光~Laser line and Stokes-scattered light
units.title: 非彈性散射與拉曼位移~Inelastic scattering and the Raman shift
units.mechanism: 雷射電場使分子電子雲極化，誘導偶極主要以入射頻率振盪而產生瑞利散射；若極化率隨某個振動座標改變，誘導偶極還會出現 ν₀ ± ν_vib 的邊帶，這就是拉曼散射。失去一個振動量子的是斯托克斯線，取得一個量子的是反斯托克斯線，後者強度受振動激發態的波茲曼佈居限制。拉曼位移 Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs 只與振動能階有關、與雷射波長無關，所以頻譜以 cm⁻¹ 為座標；散射功率約與 (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴ 成正比，短波長激發的訊號較強，但也較容易激發螢光。~The laser field polarises the molecular electron cloud and the induced dipole oscillates mainly at the incident frequency, producing Rayleigh scattering; if the polarisability changes along a vibrational coordinate, the dipole also acquires sidebands at ν₀ ± ν_vib, which is Raman scattering. Losing one vibrational quantum gives the Stokes line and gaining one gives the anti-Stokes line, whose strength is limited by the Boltzmann population of the excited level. The Raman shift Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs depends only on the vibrational levels and not on the laser wavelength, so spectra are plotted in cm⁻¹; scattered power scales roughly as (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴, so shorter-wavelength excitation gives stronger signals but also excites fluorescence more easily.
units.model: 532.0 nm 雷射的 ν̃₀ = 18 797 cm⁻¹，矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 光學聲子的斯托克斯線落在 1/(18 797 − 520.7) cm⁻¹ = 547.16 nm，反斯托克斯線在 517.66 nm。295 K 時反斯托克斯／斯托克斯強度比 = exp(−1.4388×520.7/295) × ((18 797 + 520.7)/(18 797 − 520.7))⁴ = 0.0789 × 1.248 ≈ 0.098；溫度升到 323 K 時比值變成 0.123，可當作局部溫度計。1000 cm⁻¹ 的振動以 785 nm 激發時散射光在 851.9 nm，散射功率比 532 nm 激發低 (17 797/11 739)⁴ ≈ 5.3 倍。~A 532.0 nm laser has ν̃₀ = 18 797 cm⁻¹, so the Stokes line of the 520.7 cm⁻¹ silicon optical phonon falls at 1/(18 797 − 520.7) cm⁻¹ = 547.16 nm and the anti-Stokes line at 517.66 nm. At 295 K the anti-Stokes/Stokes ratio is exp(−1.4388×520.7/295) × ((18 797 + 520.7)/(18 797 − 520.7))⁴ = 0.0789 × 1.248 ≈ 0.098; at 323 K it becomes 0.123, which makes it a local thermometer. A 1000 cm⁻¹ vibration excited at 785 nm scatters at 851.9 nm with (17 797/11 739)⁴ ≈ 5.3 times less power than under 532 nm excitation.
units.verify: 以 1 mW 以下的低功率量測矽晶片，確認斯托克斯峰在 520.7 cm⁻¹ 附近；改用陷波濾光片（長波通邊緣濾光片會擋掉反斯托克斯側）同時記錄反斯托克斯峰，以強度比與上式反推等效溫度，應接近室溫；再以 785 nm 雷射量同一片聚苯乙烯，確認 1001.4 cm⁻¹ 峰位不隨激發波長改變，而絕對計數依 ν⁴ 與偵測器量子效率下降。~Measure a silicon wafer at 1 mW or less and confirm the Stokes peak near 520.7 cm⁻¹; with a notch filter (a long-pass edge filter blocks the anti-Stokes side) record the anti-Stokes peak as well and invert the intensity ratio with the formula above to an effective temperature that should be close to ambient; then measure the same polystyrene with a 785 nm laser and confirm that the 1001.4 cm⁻¹ peak position is unchanged while absolute counts fall with ν⁴ and detector quantum efficiency.
units.failure: 換了雷射或雷射波長漂移後仍沿用舊的 λ₀ 換算，整條位移軸平移，0.2 nm 的差異在 532 nm 就是約 7 cm⁻¹，比對資料庫時錯認物相；以反斯托克斯比值測溫卻沒有修正偵測器在兩側的響應差異，推得的溫度可錯 20 K 以上。~Keeping the old λ₀ after a laser change or wavelength drift shifts the whole shift axis, and a 0.2 nm difference at 532 nm is about 7 cm⁻¹, enough to misidentify phases against a library; using the anti-Stokes ratio as a thermometer without correcting the detector response on the two sides can put the inferred temperature off by more than 20 K.
units.misconception: 拉曼位移會隨雷射波長改變，所以不同雷射量到的峰位不能互相比較。~The Raman shift changes with laser wavelength, so peak positions from different lasers cannot be compared.

units.anchor: 物鏡焦點與共軛焦針孔~Objective focus and confocal pinhole
units.title: 共軛焦取樣體積與光子預算~Confocal sampling volume and photon budget
units.mechanism: 拉曼顯微光譜儀以高數值孔徑物鏡把雷射聚成繞射極限光點，同一支物鏡以背向散射幾何收集拉曼光，再經過與焦點共軛的針孔或狹縫，只讓焦平面附近的散射光進入光譜儀。橫向取樣直徑約 1.22λ/NA，軸向取樣深度由針孔大小決定，通常是橫向的兩到三倍；針孔越小深度越淺但通量越低。拉曼微分截面只有 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr 等級，計數率正比於雷射光子數、分子數密度、取樣長度、收集立體角與光路透射率，任何一項打折都直接轉成更長的積分時間。~A Raman microspectrometer focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot with a high-numerical-aperture objective, collects the Raman light through the same objective in backscattering geometry, and passes it through a pinhole or slit conjugate to the focus so only light from near the focal plane enters the spectrometer. The lateral sampling diameter is about 1.22λ/NA while the axial sampling depth is set by the pinhole and is typically two to three times larger; a smaller pinhole gives a shallower depth but less throughput. Raman differential cross-sections are only of order 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr, and the count rate is proportional to laser photon flux, molecular number density, sampled length, collection solid angle and optical transmission, so any loss turns directly into longer integration.
units.model: 10 mW、532 nm 雷射每秒 2.68×10¹⁶ 個光子。以苯的 992 cm⁻¹ 峰為例，假設 dσ/dΩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr、分子數密度 6.76×10²¹ cm⁻³、有效取樣長度 2 µm、NA 0.9 的收集立體角 2π(1 − cos 64.2°) ≈ 3.54 sr、光路透射率 0.2、CCD 量子效率 0.9：計數率 ≈ 2.68×10¹⁶ × 3×10⁻²⁹ × 6.76×10²¹ × 2×10⁻⁴ × 3.54 × 0.18 ≈ 6.9×10⁵ s⁻¹，只佔入射光子的 2.6×10⁻¹¹。橫向光點直徑 1.22×0.532/0.9 ≈ 0.72 µm。~A 10 mW, 532 nm laser delivers 2.68×10¹⁶ photons per second. For the 992 cm⁻¹ band of benzene, assuming dσ/dΩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr, number density 6.76×10²¹ cm⁻³, an effective sampled length of 2 µm, a collection solid angle 2π(1 − cos 64.2°) ≈ 3.54 sr for NA 0.9, optical transmission 0.2 and CCD quantum efficiency 0.9, the count rate is about 2.68×10¹⁶ × 3×10⁻²⁹ × 6.76×10²¹ × 2×10⁻⁴ × 3.54 × 0.18 ≈ 6.9×10⁵ s⁻¹, only 2.6×10⁻¹¹ of the incident photons. The lateral spot diameter is 1.22×0.532/0.9 ≈ 0.72 µm.
units.verify: 以矽晶片沿 Z 軸穿越焦點掃描，記錄 520.7 cm⁻¹ 峰強度對位置的曲線，其半高寬即為軸向取樣深度；針孔由 200 µm 縮到 50 µm 時應看到深度變淺、峰值計數下降。橫向以矽上金屬線邊緣掃描取 10–90% 寬度；再以純液體標準品在固定功率下量計數率並與光子預算比較，差異超過兩倍就檢查準直與針孔對位。~Scan a silicon wafer through focus along Z and record the 520.7 cm⁻¹ peak intensity versus position; its full width at half maximum is the axial sampling depth, and shrinking the pinhole from 200 µm to 50 µm should make the depth shallower and the peak counts lower. For lateral resolution scan across a metal line edge on silicon and take the 10–90% width; then measure a neat liquid standard at fixed power and compare the count rate with the photon budget, checking collimation and pinhole alignment if they differ by more than a factor of two.
units.failure: 對透明聚合物做深度剖析時忽略折射，乾物鏡的平台移動 10 µm 時實際焦點移動約 n 倍以上，軸向取樣也被大幅拉長，層厚與界面位置都被誤判；針孔偏離共軛位置讓計數下降一半以上，使用者誤以為樣品訊號弱而加大雷射功率，結果燒傷樣品。~Ignoring refraction when depth-profiling a transparent polymer means that a 10 µm stage move with a dry objective shifts the real focus by roughly n times or more and stretches the axial sampling, so layer thicknesses and interfaces are misjudged; a pinhole off its conjugate position halves the counts or worse, and users who blame a weak sample raise the laser power and burn it.
units.misconception: 共軛焦拉曼的深度解析度和橫向解析度一樣，都是次微米。~Confocal Raman depth resolution equals the lateral resolution, both sub-micrometre.

units.anchor: 雷射淨化濾光片與邊緣濾光片~Laser clean-up and edge filters
units.title: 雷射光源與瑞利光抑制~Laser source and Rayleigh rejection
units.mechanism: 拉曼雷射需要窄線寬與穩定波長：線寬直接疊加到每一條拉曼峰上，波長漂移則直接變成位移誤差。半導體雷射的放大自發放射背景與氣體雷射的電漿線必須用窄帶淨化濾光片去除，否則會在頻譜上出現假峰。收集端的瑞利光與鏡面反射比拉曼光強六到十個數量級，需要光學密度 OD 6 以上的干涉式長波通邊緣濾光片或體布拉格光柵陷波濾光片；濾光片的過渡帶寬決定能量測的最低波數，入射角偏離設計值則讓截止邊往短波長移動。~A Raman laser needs a narrow linewidth and a stable wavelength: the linewidth convolves into every Raman band and wavelength drift becomes shift error directly. Amplified spontaneous emission from diode lasers and plasma lines from gas lasers must be removed with a narrow clean-up filter or they appear as false peaks. On the collection side Rayleigh light and specular reflection are six to ten orders of magnitude stronger than the Raman light, so an interference long-pass edge filter or a volume-Bragg-grating notch filter with optical density OD 6 or more is required; the filter transition width sets the lowest measurable wavenumber, and tilting away from the design angle moves the edge toward shorter wavelength.
units.model: 邊緣濾光片過渡帶若為波長的 0.3%，在 532 nm 是 1.6 nm，換算 Δν̃ = Δλ/λ² = 1.6×10⁻⁷ cm/(5.32×10⁻⁵ cm)² ≈ 56 cm⁻¹，實用量測下限約 60–80 cm⁻¹；體布拉格光柵陷波濾光片可推到 10 cm⁻¹ 以下。等效折射率 n_eff = 2.0 的濾光片傾斜 5° 時，截止邊移動 λ₀(1 − √(1 − sin²5°/4)) ≈ 532 × 9.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.51 nm ≈ 18 cm⁻¹。雷射線寬 0.1 nm 相當於 3.5 cm⁻¹，會讓矽峰明顯變寬。~If the edge-filter transition is 0.3% of the wavelength, at 532 nm it is 1.6 nm, or Δν̃ = Δλ/λ² = 1.6×10⁻⁷ cm/(5.32×10⁻⁵ cm)² ≈ 56 cm⁻¹, so the practical lower limit is about 60–80 cm⁻¹; a volume-Bragg-grating notch filter reaches below 10 cm⁻¹. Tilting a filter of effective index n_eff = 2.0 by 5° moves its edge by λ₀(1 − √(1 − sin²5°/4)) ≈ 532 × 9.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 0.51 nm ≈ 18 cm⁻¹. A 0.1 nm laser linewidth equals 3.5 cm⁻¹ and visibly broadens the silicon band.
units.verify: 將衰減後的雷射光直接導入光譜儀量線寬與側帶；以白色漫射參考片在低功率下比較有、無淨化濾光片的頻譜，標出放大自發放射背景與電漿線位置並確認裝上後消失；以矽或鑽石樣品確認瑞利殘光在 100 cm⁻¹ 處降到暗計數水準，並用氖燈線找出截止邊的實際位置與規格比較，每次重新安裝濾光片後重做。~Send attenuated laser light straight into the spectrometer to measure linewidth and sidebands; compare spectra of a white diffuse reference at low power with and without the clean-up filter, mark the ASE background and plasma lines and confirm that they vanish with the filter in place; on silicon or diamond confirm that residual Rayleigh light falls to the dark-count level by 100 cm⁻¹, locate the actual edge with neon lines and compare with the specification, repeating after every filter reinstallation.
units.failure: 淨化濾光片老化或裝反，放大自發放射背景與電漿線穿過系統，在 200–600 cm⁻¹ 之間出現與樣品無關的窄峰而被誤判為新物相；邊緣濾光片受潮或傾斜讓截止邊移動，MoS₂ 等層狀材料低於 50 cm⁻¹ 的層間剪切模態被截掉，層數判定錯誤。~An aged or reversed clean-up filter lets ASE background and plasma lines through, producing narrow sample-independent peaks between 200 and 600 cm⁻¹ that are mistaken for new phases; a humidity-damaged or tilted edge filter moves its cut-off so the sub-50 cm⁻¹ interlayer shear modes of layered materials such as MoS₂ are removed and layer counts are misjudged.
units.misconception: 只要邊緣濾光片的 OD 夠高，就能量到任意低的拉曼位移。~With a high enough optical density, an edge filter lets you measure arbitrarily low Raman shifts.

units.anchor: 光柵光譜儀與 CCD 陣列~Grating spectrograph and CCD array
units.title: 光柵色散、狹縫與光譜解析度~Grating dispersion, slit and spectral resolution
units.mechanism: 通過共軛焦針孔的拉曼光進入 Czerny–Turner 光譜儀：入口狹縫經準直鏡成為平行光，光柵依 mλ = d(sin α + sin β) 把不同波長分到不同角度，再由聚焦鏡成像到背照式 CCD。倒線色散 dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) 決定每個像素對應的波數，狹縫影像寬度決定儀器線寬，CCD 長度決定單次曝光涵蓋的範圍；高刻線密度與長焦距提升解析度，卻縮小範圍並使寬頻譜需要拼接。CCD 以熱電或液態氮致冷到 −60 °C 以下壓低暗電流，並沿狹縫方向合併像素以降低讀出雜訊的比重。~Raman light leaving the confocal pinhole enters a Czerny–Turner spectrograph: the entrance slit is collimated, the grating sends each wavelength to a different angle through mλ = d(sin α + sin β), and a focusing mirror images the spectrum onto a back-illuminated CCD. The reciprocal linear dispersion dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) sets the wavenumber per pixel, the slit image width sets the instrument linewidth and the CCD length sets the range covered per exposure; denser gratings and longer focal lengths improve resolution but shrink the range so broad spectra must be stitched. The CCD is cooled thermoelectrically or with liquid nitrogen below −60 °C to suppress dark current, and pixels are binned along the slit to reduce the weight of read noise.
units.model: f = 800 mm、1800 gr/mm 光柵、矽峰 547.16 nm，近 Littrow 角 β ≈ 29.5°：dλ/dx = 0.870/(1.8×10⁶ m⁻¹ × 0.8 m) ≈ 0.604 nm/mm；26 µm 像素對應 0.0157 nm ≈ 0.52 cm⁻¹；100 µm 狹縫的帶通 0.060 nm ≈ 2.0 cm⁻¹；1024 像素涵蓋 16.1 nm ≈ 537 cm⁻¹。換成 600 gr/mm 光柵時每像素約 1.78 cm⁻¹，一次涵蓋約 1830 cm⁻¹，適合指紋區篩檢，卻無法分辨 0.5 cm⁻¹ 等級的應力位移。~With f = 800 mm, a 1800 gr/mm grating and the silicon band at 547.16 nm near a Littrow angle β ≈ 29.5°, dλ/dx = 0.870/(1.8×10⁶ m⁻¹ × 0.8 m) ≈ 0.604 nm/mm; a 26 µm pixel spans 0.0157 nm ≈ 0.52 cm⁻¹, a 100 µm slit passes 0.060 nm ≈ 2.0 cm⁻¹ and 1024 pixels cover 16.1 nm ≈ 537 cm⁻¹. A 600 gr/mm grating gives about 1.78 cm⁻¹ per pixel and covers about 1830 cm⁻¹ at once, good for fingerprint screening but unable to resolve stress shifts of order 0.5 cm⁻¹.
units.verify: 以氖或氬燈的窄原子線量測儀器線形，半高寬應接近狹縫帶通的計算值；在 CCD 中央與兩端各取燈線，確認色散非線性並以三次多項式擬合像素到波長；關閉快門取多張暗框，量測 CCD 暗電流與讀出雜訊，作為後續訊噪比預算的輸入。~Measure the instrument line shape with narrow neon or argon atomic lines, whose full width at half maximum should approach the calculated slit bandpass; take lamp lines at the centre and both ends of the CCD to confirm the dispersion nonlinearity and fit pixel-to-wavelength with a cubic polynomial; acquire several closed-shutter dark frames to measure CCD dark current and read noise as inputs to the signal-to-noise budget.
units.failure: 為了通量把狹縫開得太大，儀器線寬超過 5 cm⁻¹，相差 3 cm⁻¹ 的兩個晶型峰合併成一個，藥物多晶型被誤判；光柵轉台的回位誤差讓頻譜中心偏移，若每次轉動後未重新校正，拼接頻譜的接縫處出現台階與峰位跳動。~Opening the slit too far for throughput pushes the instrument linewidth above 5 cm⁻¹, so two polymorph bands 3 cm⁻¹ apart merge and the polymorph is misidentified; repositioning error of the grating turret shifts the spectral centre, and without recalibration after each move stitched spectra show steps and jumping peak positions at the seams.
units.misconception: 刻線越密、焦距越長的光譜儀在任何量測都是最好的選擇。~A denser grating and longer focal length are the best choice for every measurement.

units.anchor: 矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 與氖燈校正線~Si 520.7 cm⁻¹ and neon calibration lines
units.title: 波數軸校正與應力量測靈敏度~Wavenumber-axis calibration and stress sensitivity
units.mechanism: 波數軸校正分兩步：先用氖、氬或汞燈已知的原子線把像素對應到絕對波長，修正光柵角與色散非線性；再用矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 或其他已知拉曼峰定出雷射的實際波長，也就是零位移點，因為雷射波長漂移會讓整條位移軸平移。以矽峰位做應力計量時，單軸應力約每 cm⁻¹ 對應 500 MPa，所以 0.1 cm⁻¹ 的校正誤差就是 50 MPa 的應力誤差；峰位必須以洛倫茲或 Voigt 函數擬合取得次像素精度，燈線與雷射波長也必須一致地使用空氣或真空值。~Wavenumber calibration has two steps: atomic lines of known wavelength from neon, argon or mercury lamps map pixels to absolute wavelength and correct the grating angle and dispersion nonlinearity, then the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band or another known Raman band fixes the actual laser wavelength, the zero-shift point, because laser drift translates the whole shift axis. For stress metrology from the silicon band, roughly 500 MPa of uniaxial stress corresponds to 1 cm⁻¹, so a 0.1 cm⁻¹ calibration error is a 50 MPa stress error; peak positions must be fitted with Lorentzian or Voigt functions to sub-pixel precision, and lamp and laser wavelengths must consistently be air or vacuum values.
units.model: 雷射實際波長由 532.000 nm 漂到 532.010 nm 而未重校，位移軸平移 Δλ₀/λ₀² = 1×10⁻⁹ cm/(5.32×10⁻⁵ cm)² ≈ 0.35 cm⁻¹，相當於約 0.35 × 500 ≈ 177 MPa 的單軸應力誤差。把空氣波長的燈線與真空波長的雷射混用，空氣折射率 1.000278 造成 18 797 × 2.78×10⁻⁴ ≈ 5.2 cm⁻¹ 的偏移。1800 gr/mm 時每像素 0.52 cm⁻¹，峰位擬合精度 0.05 cm⁻¹ 約為 1/10 像素，對應應力解析度約 25 MPa。~If the laser drifts from 532.000 nm to 532.010 nm without recalibration, the shift axis moves by Δλ₀/λ₀² = 1×10⁻⁹ cm/(5.32×10⁻⁵ cm)² ≈ 0.35 cm⁻¹, about 0.35 × 500 ≈ 177 MPa of uniaxial stress error. Mixing air-wavelength lamp lines with a vacuum-wavelength laser value introduces 18 797 × 2.78×10⁻⁴ ≈ 5.2 cm⁻¹ through the air index 1.000278. At 0.52 cm⁻¹ per pixel with a 1800 gr/mm grating, a 0.05 cm⁻¹ fit precision is about one tenth of a pixel and a stress resolution near 25 MPa.
units.verify: 每次開機以至少三條氖燈線擬合色散並記錄殘差，應小於 0.1 像素；接著以低功率量無應力矽晶片，以洛倫茲擬合峰位並把零位移修正到 520.7 cm⁻¹；再以聚苯乙烯或 ASTM E1840 列出的位移標準物在 600–3100 cm⁻¹ 的多條峰檢查整條位移軸，偏差應小於 ±1 cm⁻¹；量測期間每小時重量矽峰追蹤漂移。~At every start-up fit the dispersion with at least three neon lines and log the residuals, which should be below 0.1 pixel; then measure an unstressed silicon wafer at low power, fit the peak with a Lorentzian and correct the zero shift to 520.7 cm⁻¹; check the whole shift axis with several bands between 600 and 3100 cm⁻¹ of polystyrene or another ASTM E1840 shift standard, expecting deviations within ±1 cm⁻¹; re-measure the silicon band every hour during a session to track drift.
units.failure: 只在早上校正一次，實驗室溫度漂移 2 K 讓光譜儀與雷射波長改變，下午量到的矽峰偏移 0.3 cm⁻¹，被報告成 150 MPa 的應力差異；不同機台各自校正卻採用不同的矽參考值（520.0 對 520.7 cm⁻¹），跨廠資料出現系統性不一致。~Calibrating only once in the morning while the laboratory drifts 2 K changes the spectrometer and laser wavelength, so afternoon silicon peaks shift 0.3 cm⁻¹ and are reported as a 150 MPa stress difference; instruments calibrated separately against different silicon reference values (520.0 versus 520.7 cm⁻¹) produce systematically inconsistent data between sites.
units.misconception: 只要用矽片把峰位調到 520.7 cm⁻¹，整條波數軸就都準了。~Setting the silicon peak to 520.7 cm⁻¹ makes the whole wavenumber axis correct.

units.anchor: 螢光背景與 CCD 雜訊底~Fluorescence background and CCD noise floor
units.title: 螢光背景、散粒雜訊與激發波長選擇~Fluorescence background, shot noise and excitation choice
units.mechanism: 拉曼截面比螢光小很多個數量級，樣品或雜質只要有微量螢光，寬廣的背景就會淹沒拉曼峰。背景可以用多項式扣掉平均值，但其散粒雜訊 √B 會留在頻譜裡，所以真正的訊噪比是 S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²)。對策包括改用 785 或 1064 nm 激發避開電子吸收、以雷射預先光漂白、時間閘控或移頻激發差分；換長波長會因 ν⁴ 與 CCD 量子效率下降而損失訊號，必須以訊噪比而非訊號大小決策。不同設定的相對強度還需用 NIST SRM 2241（785 nm 用）等螢光標準玻璃做儀器響應校正。~Raman cross-sections are many orders of magnitude smaller than fluorescence, so a trace of fluorescence from the sample or an impurity buries the Raman bands under a broad background. A polynomial can subtract the mean background but its shot noise √B remains, so the true signal-to-noise ratio is S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²). Remedies include 785 or 1064 nm excitation to avoid electronic absorption, photobleaching with the laser beforehand, time gating or shifted-excitation difference methods; longer wavelengths lose signal through ν⁴ and falling CCD quantum efficiency, so the decision must rest on signal-to-noise rather than signal size. Relative intensities across settings also need instrument-response correction with fluorescent standard glasses such as NIST SRM 2241 for 785 nm.
units.model: 532 nm 激發 1 s：拉曼 S = 2000 計數、螢光 B = 2×10⁵ 計數，SNR = 2000/√(2.02×10⁵) ≈ 4.4。改用 785 nm：等功率下光子數依 ν_s³ 少 3.48 倍、CCD 量子效率由 0.90 降到 0.45 再少 2 倍，S ≈ 287；螢光假設降低 1000 倍成 200，SNR = 287/√487 ≈ 13。訊號小了 7 倍，訊噪比反而提高約 3 倍。~With 532 nm excitation for 1 s the Raman signal is S = 2000 counts on a fluorescence background B = 2×10⁵ counts, so SNR = 2000/√(2.02×10⁵) ≈ 4.4. Switching to 785 nm, the photon count at equal power falls 3.48 times through ν_s³ and the CCD quantum efficiency drops from 0.90 to 0.45 for another factor of 2, leaving S ≈ 287; assuming fluorescence falls 1000-fold to 200, SNR = 287/√487 ≈ 13. The signal is seven times smaller yet the signal-to-noise ratio improves about threefold.
units.verify: 在兩種雷射下量同一樣品的 S 與 B，以多幀重複計算每個像素的標準差，確認雜訊與 √(S + B) 吻合；以 SRM 2241 在相同光路量得的響應除以證書提供的多項式得到修正函數，套用後比較同一聚苯乙烯在兩台儀器上的相對峰強比，差異應落在 5% 內。~Measure S and B on the same sample with both lasers and compute the per-pixel standard deviation from repeated frames to confirm that noise follows √(S + B); divide the SRM 2241 response measured through the same optical path by the certified polynomial to obtain a correction function, apply it and compare relative band ratios of the same polystyrene on two instruments, which should agree within 5%.
units.failure: 為了讓背景看起來平坦而使用高階多項式扣除，連寬拉曼帶（如非晶碳 D、G 帶的肩部）一起扣掉，定量比值 I_D/I_G 失真；在強螢光下拉長積分時間直到 CCD 飽和，飽和像素讓拉曼峰被截頂，峰面積與峰位都不可信。~Subtracting a high-order polynomial to make the background look flat also removes broad Raman bands such as the shoulders of the amorphous-carbon D and G bands, distorting the I_D/I_G ratio; lengthening integration under strong fluorescence until the CCD saturates clips the Raman peaks in saturated pixels, so neither peak area nor position can be trusted.
units.misconception: 螢光背景可以用基線扣除完全移除，不影響訊噪比。~Fluorescence background can be removed completely by baseline subtraction without affecting the signal-to-noise ratio.

units.anchor: 雷射功率密度與成像平台~Laser irradiance and mapping stage
units.title: 雷射加熱、樣品損傷與拉曼成像整合~Laser heating, sample damage and Raman-imaging integration
units.mechanism: 高 NA 物鏡把數 mW 集中在不到 1 µm 的光點，峰值功率密度達 MW/cm² 等級，被吸收的功率造成局部升溫；溫升與熱導率和光點半徑成反比，所以矽只升高數十 K，深色聚合物、碳材或生物組織卻可能燒毀或相變。升溫會讓峰位紅移、線寬變寬，若與應力或成分訊號混在一起就無法分離。拉曼成像把電動平台、自動對焦、曝光與讀出同步，整幅影像所需時間、焦面平整度與宇宙射線尖峰的處理都必須事先預算。~A high-NA objective concentrates a few milliwatts into a spot under 1 µm, giving peak irradiance of order MW/cm², and absorbed power heats the sample locally; the temperature rise scales inversely with thermal conductivity and spot radius, so silicon warms by only tens of kelvin while dark polymers, carbon materials or biological tissue may burn or change phase. Heating red-shifts and broadens bands and cannot be separated once it mixes with stress or composition signals. Raman imaging synchronises a motorised stage, autofocus, exposure and readout, so total map time, focal-plane flatness and cosmic-ray spike handling must all be budgeted in advance.
units.model: 10 mW 打在 1/e 半徑 w = 0.4 µm 的光點（峰值約 2 MW/cm²），矽反射 37% 後吸收 6.3 mW，κ = 148 W/(m·K)：ΔT ≈ P/(2√π·κ·w) = 6.3×10⁻³/(2×1.772×148×0.4×10⁻⁶) ≈ 30 K，峰位以 −0.022 cm⁻¹/K 移動約 −0.66 cm⁻¹。成像：100 × 100 µm、步距 0.5 µm 共 201 × 201 = 40 401 條頻譜，每條 0.1 s 曝光加 20 ms 讀出，總計約 81 分鐘；樣品傾斜 0.5° 時 100 µm 內高度差 0.87 µm，已接近軸向取樣深度。~Focusing 10 mW to a spot of 1/e radius w = 0.4 µm (about 2 MW/cm² peak) on silicon, which reflects 37% and absorbs 6.3 mW with κ = 148 W/(m·K), gives ΔT ≈ P/(2√π·κ·w) = 6.3×10⁻³/(2×1.772×148×0.4×10⁻⁶) ≈ 30 K, shifting the band by about −0.66 cm⁻¹ at −0.022 cm⁻¹/K. Imaging 100 × 100 µm at 0.5 µm steps means 201 × 201 = 40 401 spectra, and at 0.1 s exposure plus 20 ms readout the map takes about 81 minutes; a 0.5° sample tilt changes height by 0.87 µm across 100 µm, close to the axial sampling depth.
units.verify: 以功率序列（0.5、1、2、5、10 mW）量矽峰位與線寬，外插到零功率得到無加熱峰位，並以反斯托克斯／斯托克斯比值交叉檢驗溫升；成像前在四個角落對焦求出平面方程或啟用自動對焦，影像中放入已知節距的參考圖形檢查平台步距；以重複曝光比對或鄰點中位數濾波標記宇宙射線尖峰。~Run a power series (0.5, 1, 2, 5 and 10 mW) on silicon, record band position and width, extrapolate to zero power for the unheated position and cross-check the temperature rise with the anti-Stokes/Stokes ratio; before mapping, focus at four corners to fit a plane or enable autofocus, include a reference pattern of known pitch to check stage steps, and flag cosmic-ray spikes by repeat-exposure comparison or nearest-neighbour median filtering.
units.failure: 在碳奈米管或石墨烯上以 10 mW 長時間成像，局部升溫數百 K 造成氧化缺陷，D 峰隨量測時間增強，被誤判為樣品原有的缺陷密度；大面積成像忽略傾斜，邊緣區域失焦使強度下降一半，成分分布圖出現假的梯度。~Mapping carbon nanotubes or graphene at 10 mW for a long time heats them by hundreds of kelvin and creates oxidation defects, so the D band grows with measurement time and is mistaken for the native defect density; ignoring tilt in a large map defocuses the edges, halving the intensity and painting a false gradient into the composition image.
units.misconception: 拉曼是非破壞性量測，雷射功率越大越好。~Raman is non-destructive, so more laser power is always better.

units.anchor: 矽、氖燈與強度標準驗收表~Si, neon and intensity-standard acceptance table
units.title: 性能驗收與工程交接~Performance acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 拉曼顯微光譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：氖燈線形驗證儀器線寬與色散，矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 驗證峰位、重複性與每 mW 計數率，Z 掃描驗證共軛焦深度，SRM 強度標準驗證相對響應，功率計在樣品面量實際功率，低波數與反斯托克斯量測驗證濾光片截止邊。交接紀錄須包含每個雷射與光柵組合的校正係數、物鏡與針孔設定、量得的線寬與計數率、環境溫度與樣品安全功率上限，因為任何一項改變都會讓跨日或跨機台的比較失效。~Acceptance of a Raman microspectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: neon line shapes verify instrument linewidth and dispersion, the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band verifies position, repeatability and counts per milliwatt, a Z scan verifies confocal depth, an SRM intensity standard verifies relative response, a power meter measures the real power at the sample, and low-wavenumber and anti-Stokes measurements verify the filter edges. The handoff record must hold calibration coefficients for every laser–grating combination, objective and pinhole settings, measured linewidths and count rates, ambient temperature and the safe power limit for each sample class, because a change in any of them invalidates day-to-day or instrument-to-instrument comparison.
units.model: 驗收範例：100 µm 狹縫、1800 gr/mm 時氖線半高寬 2.0 cm⁻¹；矽本徵線寬約 2.7 cm⁻¹，預期量測線寬 √(2.7² + 2.0²) ≈ 3.4 cm⁻¹，實測 3.5 cm⁻¹ 合格；1 mW 下矽峰位 8 小時內維持 520.7 ± 0.1 cm⁻¹；計數率 1.2×10⁴ s⁻¹·mW⁻¹（100×/0.9 物鏡）；Z 掃描半高寬 1.8 µm（50 µm 針孔）；SRM 修正後聚苯乙烯 1001/1602 cm⁻¹ 峰強比與參考機台相差 3%，低於 5% 允收值。~Example acceptance: neon lines are 2.0 cm⁻¹ FWHM with a 100 µm slit and 1800 gr/mm; with an intrinsic silicon width near 2.7 cm⁻¹ the expected measured width is √(2.7² + 2.0²) ≈ 3.4 cm⁻¹ and 3.5 cm⁻¹ passes; at 1 mW the silicon band stays at 520.7 ± 0.1 cm⁻¹ over 8 hours; the count rate is 1.2×10⁴ s⁻¹·mW⁻¹ with a 100×/0.9 objective; the Z-scan FWHM is 1.8 µm with a 50 µm pinhole; after SRM correction the polystyrene 1001/1602 cm⁻¹ band ratio differs from the reference instrument by 3%, inside the 5% allowance.
units.verify: 依固定順序執行：樣品面雷射功率、氖燈色散與線寬、矽峰位與功率序列、Z 方向共軛焦響應、SRM 相對強度修正、聚苯乙烯全範圍峰位、低波數截止邊；每項結果與模型值並列於驗收表，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做校正，再把結果與設定檔一起存檔交接。~Execute in a fixed order: laser power at the sample, neon dispersion and linewidth, silicon position and power series, confocal Z response, SRM relative-intensity correction, full-range polystyrene positions and the low-wavenumber edge; enter each result beside its model value in the acceptance table, record the cause and recalibrate whenever an item exceeds its allowance, and archive the results together with the settings files for handoff.
units.failure: 只驗收 532 nm 一組設定，使用者改用 785 nm 與 600 gr/mm 光柵量藥品時沒有對應的校正，峰位偏 2 cm⁻¹、相對強度偏 30%，跨機台的多晶型判定與定量全部失準；交接紀錄沒有樣品安全功率，新使用者以預設全功率燒壞稀有樣品。~Accepting only the 532 nm configuration leaves users who switch to 785 nm and a 600 gr/mm grating for pharmaceuticals without matching calibration, so peaks are off by 2 cm⁻¹ and relative intensities by 30%, ruining cross-instrument polymorph identification and quantitation; a handoff record without safe power limits lets a new user burn a rare sample at the default full power.
units.misconception: 頻譜上看到的峰寬就是樣品的真實線寬，不必考慮儀器線寬。~The peak width seen in a spectrum is the true band width, with no instrument contribution.

example: 應變矽量測練習：以 532.000 nm 雷射、1800 gr/mm 光柵（0.52 cm⁻¹/像素）量測應變矽通道。無應力參考片在 1 mW（升溫僅約 3 K，忽略）量得 520.70 cm⁻¹ 作為零點。樣品在 10 mW 下的峰值擬合在 547.125 nm，Δν̃ = 18 796.99 − 1/(547.125×10⁻⁷ cm) = 18 796.99 − 18 277.36 ≈ 519.63 cm⁻¹。10 mW 造成約 30 K 升溫、峰位 −0.66 cm⁻¹，修正後 520.29 cm⁻¹，Δω = −0.41 cm⁻¹，以 σ ≈ −500 MPa × Δω 得單軸拉伸應力約 +205 MPa；若忘記加熱修正，Δω = −1.07 cm⁻¹ 會被報成 +535 MPa，高估 2.6 倍。峰位擬合精度 ±0.05 cm⁻¹（約 1/10 像素）對應 ±25 MPa；若雷射漂移 0.01 nm 而未以參考片重校，再多出 0.35 cm⁻¹ ≈ 177 MPa 的誤差。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Strained-silicon exercise: a strained silicon channel is measured with a 532.000 nm laser and a 1800 gr/mm grating (0.52 cm⁻¹ per pixel). An unstressed reference measured at 1 mW (heating only about 3 K, neglected) reads 520.70 cm⁻¹ and sets the zero. The sample at 10 mW fits to a peak at 547.125 nm, so Δν̃ = 18 796.99 − 1/(547.125×10⁻⁷ cm) = 18 796.99 − 18 277.36 ≈ 519.63 cm⁻¹. The 10 mW beam heats by about 30 K and shifts the band −0.66 cm⁻¹, so the corrected value is 520.29 cm⁻¹, Δω = −0.41 cm⁻¹, and σ ≈ −500 MPa × Δω gives about +205 MPa uniaxial tension; forgetting the heating correction reports Δω = −1.07 cm⁻¹ as +535 MPa, a 2.6-fold overestimate. A fit precision of ±0.05 cm⁻¹ (about one tenth of a pixel) corresponds to ±25 MPa, and an uncorrected 0.01 nm laser drift adds 0.35 cm⁻¹ ≈ 177 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1928 年 C. V. Raman 與 K. S. Krishnan 在加爾各答以濾過的太陽光與汞燈觀察到液體的非彈性散射，同年 Landsberg 與 Mandelstam 在莫斯科於石英中獨立發現同一效應，Raman 於 1930 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1960 年代雷射讓拉曼光譜成為實用技術，1975 年 Delhaye 與 Dhamelincourt 在法國里爾發表雷射拉曼微探針，由 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）商品化；1990 年代 CCD、全像陷波濾光片與共軛焦設計讓拉曼顯微光譜儀成為材料、半導體應力與製藥分析的日常工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1928 C. V. Raman and K. S. Krishnan in Calcutta observed inelastic scattering from liquids using filtered sunlight and mercury lamps, while Landsberg and Mandelstam in Moscow independently found the same effect in quartz that year, and Raman received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics. Lasers made Raman spectroscopy practical in the 1960s, and in 1975 Delhaye and Dhamelincourt in Lille published the laser Raman microprobe that Jobin Yvon, now HORIBA, commercialised; in the 1990s CCDs, holographic notch filters and confocal designs made the Raman microspectrometer a routine tool for materials, semiconductor stress and pharmaceutical analysis. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
